name: pr-workflows
description: Build reviewable PR stacks and write descriptions reviewers can use.

interface.shortDescription: Reviewable PR stacks and useful descriptions
interface.longDescription: Plan independently green pull request stacks, keep their relationships clear, and write concise descriptions that tell reviewers what changed and why.
defaultPrompt: Split this large change into a reviewable stack of pull requests.
Write a concise pull request description for this change.
Restack these pull requests after their base changed.
